title: Find the Range of f
text:
For $f(x) = x^2 - 4$ where $x \geq 0$:

- When $x = 0$: $f(0) = 0 - 4 = -4$
- As $x$ increases, $f(x)$ increases

Range of $f$: $y \geq -4$

title: Apply the Relationship
text:
Key principle: Domain of $f^{-1}$ = Range of $f$

Since Range of $f$ is $y \geq -4$, the Domain of $f^{-1}$ is $x \geq -4$.

title: State the Domain
text:
Domain of $f^{-1}$: $x \geq -4$ or $x \in [-4; \infty)$

This also makes sense because we need $x + 4 \geq 0$ under the square root.
